sentences.text: Aritra vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 27 March, 2026

Author: Hiranmay Bhattacharyya
Bench: Hiranmay Bhattacharyya
D/L- 24 Wpa 3912 of 2026
27/03/2026
Ct. No.-19 Monoranjan Dhara
Aritra Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. Tanmay Chowdhury
 Ms. Ritoprita Ghosh
 Ms. Sulagna Sarkar
 ....for the petitioner
 Ms. Manika Roy
 Mr. Sabyasachi Roy
 Mr. Atanu Sur
 ....for the Nhai
 Mr. Pritam Choudhury
 Mr. Krishna Deodas
 ....for the State

The petitioner has approached the arbitrator under Section 3G(5) of the National Highway Act, 1956,
 challenging the compensation determined by the  competent authority under the National Highway Act,
 1956.

The learned advocate appearing for the petitioner  submits that in spite of submission of the appropriate  application, the arbitrator has not taken any further steps  on the application submitted by the petitioner.

Ms. Roy, learned advocate appearing for the National  Highways Authority of India submits that the Divisional Aritra vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 27 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5380348/
1  Commissioner, Burdwan Division has been vested with the  power to act as an arbitrator under Section 3G(5) of the  1956 Act.

entities.text: Divisional Aritra vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Such submission of Ms. Roy, learned advocate,
 is placed on record.
2  State has filed a report of the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Hooghly, which is taken on record.

Since the petitioner has approached the appropriate authority under Section 3G(5) of the 1956 Act, WPA 3897 of 2026 stands disposed of by directing the Divisional Commissioner, Burdwan Division, being the respondent No.4 to dispose of the application submitted by the petitioner as expeditiously as possible but positively within a period of 8 weeks from the date of receipt of a server copy of this order.
There will be no order as to costs.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Hiranmay Bhattacharyya, J.)
